fixtures.operator_note: Firmware homes Z before XY envelope motion. For the 384-well raster row it moves to the plate start with Z up, waits for evaporation-plate confirmation, lowers to Z=91500, rasters, returns to plate start, homes Z, then homes XY. Row 2015 moves to the raster-start XY anchor before Z travel to 80000 steps. Confirm the full XY envelope is clear: X<=45000, Y<=35000, and confirm the Z travel volume at the raster-start anchor is clear. No head, fixture, cable, hand, or tool may be inside the motion volume.
